execution.remote_registration_preflight: 20 tasks,60 seed assignments; no model loaded

question: Under fresh random draws, which of the existing twenty tasks remain clean-solvable, and can runtime pairing be made independent of variant IDs?
scope: AgentDojo v1.2.2 stock in-memory clean tasks only; no attacks, fitting, planner or real endpoints
independence: New seeds on familiar previously studied tasks, not unseen tasks. No post-result task deletion. This is an eligibility/calibration study, not an attack-method result.
seed_contract: episode_seed = run_seed * 10000 + index_in_frozen_tasks * 100. All variants and injection goals for that user task use this same episode seed in a future separately authorized paired study. Variant row IDs never affect RNG seeds. Seed equality gives common initial random state, not identical subsequent token draws after paths diverge.

decision_policy.go: Freeze eligible tasks. May preregister ONE same-goal strategy-contrast pilot with independent attack-evaluation seeds and explicit shared clean/attack episode seeds. No automatic attack submission before separate protocol/tests.
decision_policy.no_go: Retain clean failure causes and all tasks. No attack generation or model fitting. Summarize this fixed multi-round cycle and pause monitoring.
decision_policy.invalid: Infrastructure failure is not scientific NO-GO. Report exact failure and wait; no automatic resubmission.
